verdict.rationale: Helicone documents a REST endpoint for querying logged requests (POST /v1/request/query) and publishes an OpenAPI spec, so an agent could programmatically pull trace data. Its HQL query language and community reports of direct SQL access against ClickHouse add further programmatic query paths. However, nothing shows an MCP server, agent-oriented tooling, or API access to aggregated metrics or eval results. missing for 10: official MCP server, documented API for querying metrics/dashboards, API access to eval/score results, hands-on evidence of agent-driven debugging via the API.
